disclosure.statement: Sentinel engine processing is local only: in V1 the engine has no feature that sends source code, evidence or findings to any external service.

host_isolation.container_note: present but not used in M1: no digest-pinned scanner images (D-22); S2/B1/B2 are NOT_RUN
host_isolation.filesystem_isolation: deny-by-default reads and writes for S1
known_gaps: file metadata (stat) readable host-wide inside S1 sandbox
memory limit not enforced on macOS
Seatbelt is not a VM boundary
host_isolation.network_isolation: denied for S1 via sandbox profile
host_isolation.rootless_containers: not verified (container isolation not implemented in M1)

integrity_note: The manifest and audit log are signed with the automatic run key. A valid signature shows integrity relative to that key only. It does not detect a same-user process that can rewrite the run folder and use the run key (D-34). A signature never proves that a finding is real.

redaction.note: Pattern-based redaction ran on evidence, findings, check reasons, logs and this result. It is not complete secret detection; see docs/m1/redaction.md for known blind spots.
